caption: The drawing depicts a bell mounted on a decorative rectangular base. The bell is brass-colored and has a crack running vertically along its body. At the top of the bell is a small metal eagle with spread wings, forming the handle or finial. Around the upper part of the bell are lines of inscribed text. The bell rests on a circular platform that is elaborately detailed with red, white, and blue rings, including a band of white stars on a blue background. The platform sits on a broader rectangular base, mostly shades of yellow, gold, and green, decorated with engraved and painted architectural scenes on the sides and a repeating leaf motif along the lower edge. The composition is centered on a plain, light beige background. In the lower left corner of the image, the artist’s signature reads “N. Amantea.”
title: Memorial Money Bank
